t: What Developmental Biology Database Is All About
title: What Developmental Biology Database Is All About
description: Development builds bodies from one cell: a human zygote divides, gastrulates into three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, endoderm), and grows organs by programmed gene expression. Hox genes lay out head-to-tail identity; morphogen gradients (like Bicoid in flies) tell cells where they are. Spemann's organizer (1924, Nobel 1935) proved one tissue can instruct others' fates. This database is the complete developmental process: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Developmental Biology Database: a complete reference database of full developmental process records.
